d: In September, the Amreli Police in Gujarat busted an alleged Rs 1,211 crore digital investment scam involving the SD Pay app, which reportedly duped more than 6.52 lakh people across the nation through a multi-level marketing (MLM) network, officials told ThePrint. Twelve people have been arrested so far in connection with the fraud, while investigators have recorded statements from around 900 individuals and received more than 800 complaints through the 1930 cybercrime helpline.
